python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,struct,os,re,collections,sys
from pathlib import Path
import cryptography
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
out=Path(os.environ['OUT']); data=Path('store/jobs/j000200/out/seed.seco').read_bytes()
records=json.loads(Path('store/jobs/j000019/out/uri_passwords.json').read_text()); records=records if isinstance(records,list) else [records]
pws={bytes.fromhex(x['password_utf8_hex']) for x in records if isinstance(x,dict) and isinstance(x.get('password_utf8_hex'),str)}
assert len(pws)==1
assert data[:4]==b'SECO' and struct.unpack('>I',data[512:516])[0]==len(data)-516
assert hashlib.sha256(data[256:]).digest()==data[224:256]
n,r,p=struct.unpack('>III',data[288:300]); assert n<=1048576 and r<=32 and p<=32
k=hashlib.scrypt(next(iter(pws)),salt=data[256:288],n=n,r=r,p=p,dklen=32)
key=AESGCM(k).decrypt(data[332:344],data[360:392]+data[344:360],None);assert len(key)==32
plain=AESGCM(key).decrypt(data[392:404],data[516:]+data[404:420],None)
(out/'seed-authenticated-payload.bin').write_bytes(plain)
keywords=['contact','client','email','storage','passphrase','mnemonic','entropy','privateKey','masterSeed','name','recipient','infobreakage','Maroni','Strange']
summary={'python':sys.version.split()[0],'cryptography':cryptography.__version__,'candidate_records':len(records),'distinct_candidates':len(pws),'checksum_valid':True,'wrapped_key_authenticated':True,'payload_authenticated':True,'plaintext_bytes':len(plain),'scrypt':{'n':n,'r':r,'p':p},'payload_retained':True,'leading_format':[],'keyword_occurrences':{},'ascii_runs_count':0,'utf8_entire_valid':False}
for label,magic in [('SQLite',b'SQLite format 3\x00'),('gzip',b'\x1f\x8b'),('zlib',b'\x78\x9c'),('SECO',b'SECO'),('JSON_object',b'{'),('JSON_array',b'['),('ZIP',b'PK\x03\x04')]:
 if plain.startswith(magic):summary['leading_format'].append(label)
for word in keywords:
 summary['keyword_occurrences'][word]={'ascii':len(list(re.finditer(re.escape(word.encode()),plain,re.I))),'utf16le':len(list(re.finditer(re.escape(word.encode('utf-16le')),plain,re.I)))}
summary['ascii_runs_count']=len(re.findall(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{4,}',plain))
try: plain.decode('utf8');summary['utf8_entire_valid']=True
except UnicodeDecodeError:pass
# Only structural JSON information is retained in this report; no values or unknown keys.
try:
 obj=json.loads(plain); summary['whole_payload_json']=True;summary['json_root_type']=type(obj).__name__
except (ValueError,UnicodeDecodeError):summary['whole_payload_json']=False
(out/'seed-structure.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True));print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
